# homarr_users (Data Source)

Lists every Homarr user, or those of one auth provider.

Any API key may read it. Homarr reserves `GET /api/users` for admins, so for another key the provider falls back to `GET /api/users/selectable`, the list behind Homarr's user pickers, which reports the same attributes. The auth provider of each user comes from that endpoint too, asked once per provider.

To find a single user, the `homarr_user` data source is simpler: it looks one up by id or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Any API key may list users: for a key that is not an admin's, the provider
# falls back to the list behind Homarr's user pickers.
data "homarr_users" "all" {}

# Users are sorted by name, then id. Names are unique only per auth provider,
# so an LDAP or OIDC account may share one with a credentials account;
# provider_name tells them apart.
output "usernames" {
  value = [for user in data.homarr_users.all.users : "${user.name} (${user.provider_name})"]
}

output "users_without_email" {
  value = [for user in data.homarr_users.all.users : user.name if user.email == null]
}

# Only the accounts that sign in through OIDC.
data "homarr_users" "oidc" {
  provider_name = "oidc"
}

output "oidc_user_ids" {
  value = data.homarr_users.oidc.users[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `provider_name` (String) Only list the users who sign in through this auth provider: `credentials`, `oidc` or `ldap`. Leave it out to list everyone.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) All users, sorted by name and then by id, with users that have no name last. Homarr itself returns them in no particular order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address of the user, or `null` if it has none. An email stored as `""`, as the UI saves a blank one, reads as `null` too, as on the `homarr_user` data source.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the user.
- `image` (String) Profile image of the user, if any: a `data:` URL of an uploaded picture, or the picture URL an OIDC provider supplied.
- `name` (String) Login name of the user, or `null` for an account Homarr stores without one. Homarr lowercases the names of credentials accounts, while LDAP and OIDC accounts keep the name their provider supplies. Names are unique only per auth provider: pair one with `provider_name` to tell such users apart.
- `provider_name` (String) Auth provider the user signs in through: `credentials`, `oidc` or `ldap`. `null` for a provider this version of the provider does not know.
